problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to load packages onto identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package 1: size 46 cubic feet
* Package 2: size 64 cubic feet
* Package 3: size 64 cubic feet
* Package 4: size 59 cubic feet
* Package 5: size 32 cubic feet
* Package 6: size 66 cubic feet
* Package 7: size 37 cubic feet
* Package 8: size 56 cubic feet
* Package 9: size 54 cubic feet
* Package 10: size 40 cubic feet
* Package 11: size 30 cubic feet
* Package 12: size 62 cubic feet
* Package 13: size 38 cubic feet
* Package 14: size 69 cubic feet
* Package 15: size 62 cubic feet
* Package 16: size 39 cubic feet
* Package 17: size 35 cubic feet
* Package 18: size 51 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Load all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be placed on exactly one truck, and the total volume of packages on any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
